Value / Buying guide

Protein powder on a budget

Use a consistent comparison instead of tub size.

Published November 1, 2026 · FitGear Authority editorial

Independent shopping guide. No paid rankings or hands-on testing claims. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

Where to start

Record the package price, number of servings, and protein per serving. Compare equivalent protein quantities across the products you are considering. Keep shipping and recurring subscription terms in the total.

What to compare

  • Total delivered price
  • Protein quantity
  • Subscription conditions
  • Return policy

How to judge value

Divide the total price by total protein grams, then multiply by 25 to compare cost for 25 grams of protein. This is a shopping unit, not a suggested dose.

Before you buy

Read the current label, confirm the seller and expiration details, and check shipping and returns. Product formulas and terms can change. Discuss suitability, medications, and health concerns with a qualified healthcare professional.
